steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2 cm cubes; peel and dice the onion.
Mince the garlic cloves and grate the fresh ginger.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook for 4 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic, grated ginger, and turmeric; stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato cubes, drained cooked white beans, unsalted vegetable broth, and coconut milk.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until the sweet potato is very tender.
Use an immersion blender to blend the soup until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the lemon juice and adjust consistency with a splash of water if needed.
Serve warm in bowls. Refrigerate up to 3 days, or freeze in portions up to 2 months.
